title: UpLoop: Training Looped Transformers via Upcycling at No Extra Pretraining Compute
abstract: arXiv:2610.41720v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped language models can strengthen reasoning through repeated computation with shared weights, increasing execution depth without adding independent parameters. However, each additional pass increases training floating-point operations (FLOPs), making these gains more expensive to obtain. To address this cost, we propose UpLoop, a pretraining schedule that uses upcycling to train looped Transformers while exactly matching a standard dense baseline in final parameter count, total training tokens, and training FLOPs. Specifically, UpLoop begins with a shallow Transformer, progressively grows its depth by copying learned layers, and uses the computation saved early to support repeated execution of a shared middle block later in training. Experiments across model scales show improvements in language modeling and downstream performance, with the average score across 22 downstream tasks increasing from 22.99 to 27.52 at 1.3B parameters. T

translated_title: UpLoop：通过升级复用以零额外预训练计算成本训练循环Transformer
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型能够通过共享权重的重复计算来增强推理能力，在不增加独立参数的情况下提高执行深度。然而，每增加一次循环都会增加训练的浮点运算量（FLOPs），使得这些收益的获取成本更高。为解决这一成本问题，我们提出了UpLoop，这是一种预训练调度方案，利用升级复用技术来训练循环Transformer，同时在最终参数量、总训练token数和训练FLOPs上与标准稠密基线完全一致。具体而言，UpLoop从一个浅层Transformer开始，通过复制已学习的层逐步增加深度，并利用早期节省的计算量来支持训练后期共享中间块的重复执行。跨多个模型规模的实验表明，该方法在语言建模和下游性能上均有提升，在1.3B参数规模下，22个下游任务的平均得分从22.99提升至27.52。
tldr: UpLoop提出一种升级复用式预训练调度方法，从浅层Transformer逐步复制层来加深模型，并将早期节省的计算用于后期共享中间块的重复执行，在与稠密基线完全相同的参数量、训练token数和FLOPs下训练循环Transformer，显著提升语言建模与下游任务性能。
en_tdlr: UpLoop trains looped Transformers via upcycling—starting shallow, progressively deepening by copying layers, and reinvesting early saved compute into repeated execution of a shared middle block—exactly matching a dense baseline in parameters, tokens, and FLOPs while improving language modeling and downstream performance.
